name: Bhai Ne Bola Karne Ka Matlab Karne Ka
visual_description: Circuit (Arshad Warsi) from Munna Bhai M.B.B.S. intimidating medical students with an aggressive, authoritative expression.
usage_context: Used to justify executing orders blindly or without hesitation simply because a senior, boss, or friend commanded it.

example.top_text: When your best friend tells you to instantly dislike someone
